args.title: Tamarack warehouse automation articles — combined summary
args.body:
Combined summary of https://blog.tamarack.example/2026/warehouse and its subscriber companion piece:

• Warehouse automation in 2026: pick rates rose 18% with the use of autonomous carts.
• Integration of the automation systems took twice as long as originally planned.
• The biggest saving came from fewer mis-picks (per the subscriber-only companion piece).
